authorization: User selection of option P0: register the beta replay read-only analysis and update the four MD records; no GPU, no dynamics.

supersedes_protocol.reason: Numerically valid and kept; two figure panels failed visual QA (clipped title, uninformative signed-offset scale). Plot-only change, no analysis-rule change.

earlier_failure.reason: previous_u8 compared across two different control layouts; three figure defects

question: The interrupted P1 run never persisted beta. D1 therefore declared the state/memory recovery incomplete and kept D3 blocked. Is beta an independent memory, or a deterministic function of the already-persisted reference chain?

inputs.replay_rule: distance[k] = min(distance[k-1] + SPEED*dur[k], ROUTE_LENGTH); beta[k] = beta[k-1] + (dur[k]/DT)*(preview(distance[k-1], beta[k-1])[0].beta_star - beta[k-1]); dur[k] recovered as time_s[k] - k*DT
inputs.validation_target: raw.npz reference_distance_m (persisted, independent of the replay)
inputs.previous_u_rule: de-interleave solver.jsonl first_control as accel = control[0::2], delta = control[1::2], then compare with the grouped raw request_accel*/request_delta* columns

claims_allowed: the accepted interval duration is recoverable from the persisted time_s labels
the reference-chain replay reproduces the persisted reference distance at float-noise level
beta is therefore recoverable from persisted artifacts by same-source-path replay
previous_u is present in the persisted raw request columns, bitwise identical to solver.jsonl first_control once the solver layout is de-interleaved
claims_forbidden: a complete, dynamically validated restart checkpoint exists
the interrupted P1 trajectory may be spliced or resumed
any GPU equivalence, speedup or control-fix conclusion
expected_figures: reconstructed beta per vehicle vs tick
recovered accepted interval duration about the 20 ms tick
identity_rule: Only immutable inputs are gated. experiment.md, exp_status.md, exp_solution.md and koopman_work_log.md are deliberately excluded because this same work updates them; gating a document that the analysis itself revises is the defect that made protocol RTX5080_G0_G2_20260915_v3 unusable after experiment.md sections 32-33 were appended.
